Key Selling Points

What to Lead With in Every Conversation

These are your strongest angles for grocery, c-store, and bodega owners. Use these to open, pivot, or close.

⚡

Speed at Checkout

Say This

"Your cashiers won't waste time hunting for products. We've got custom quick keys, favorites, and products can be added on the fly. Everything they need is one tap away on the touchscreen."

  • Custom quick keys / favorite keys — tap and go
  • Add products on the fly at the register
  • All checkout functions on the first screen — no digging through menus
  • Quick staff login and account switching
💳

Accept Every Payment Type

Say This

"You sell more when you accept everything — cash, card, contactless, mobile wallet, and EBT. We support all of it, including secure EBT transactions on both handheld and desktop devices."

  • Cash, credit, debit, contactless, mobile wallets
  • EBT/SNAP acceptance — huge for grocery and bodegas
  • Integrates with existing POS if they have one
  • Dual pricing / cash discount for $30K+/mo businesses
📦

Inventory & Product Management

Say This

"You're managing thousands of SKUs — we make that easy. Preloaded catalog, global UPC support, multi-department management, and you can track taxable vs. non-taxable items automatically."

  • Multi-layered department management
  • Preloaded product catalog with global UPC support
  • Taxable and non-taxable product support
  • Case pricing AND single item pricing
  • Vendor management built in
🏪

Multi-Store Management

Say This

"If you've got more than one location, you can manage everything from one dashboard. Shift reports by user, terminal management, inventory across stores — all centralized."

  • Multi-store management from a single dashboard
  • Shift management with reports by user
  • POS terminal management across locations
  • Cloud-based — check from your phone anywhere
🔞

Age Verification & Compliance

Say This

"If you sell tobacco, vape, or alcohol, compliance is everything. Our system has integrated ID scanning and manual age prompts so your staff never accidentally sells to a minor. That's a fine you can't afford."

  • Integrated ID scanner support for age-restricted products
  • Manual age verification prompts at checkout
  • Compliance reporting for tax and regulatory purposes
  • Excise duty management on tobacco and vape products
🏷️

Custom Label Printing

Say This

"You can print your own product labels right from the system — for deli items, in-house brands, custom blends, whatever you sell. Professional labels that meet regulatory standards."

  • Print product labels for in-house brands or custom items
  • Meets regulatory labeling standards
  • Great for delis, bakeries, and specialty items inside the store
  • CCTV camera integration for loss prevention
Know Your Prospect

Pain Points & Solutions by Vertical

Different store types have different headaches. Here's what to listen for and how to position RevitPay.

🛒

Grocery / Supermarket

Common Pain Points
  • Managing thousands of SKUs across departments
  • Slow checkout lines losing customers
  • No EBT/SNAP support on current system
  • Inventory shrinkage and theft
  • Can't track performance across multiple registers
How We Solve It
  • Preloaded catalog with global UPC support
  • Quick keys and favorites for fast checkout
  • Full EBT/SNAP transaction support
  • CCTV camera integration for loss prevention
  • Multi-terminal management with shift reports
  • Integrated scale support for produce
🏪

Convenience / C-Store

Common Pain Points
  • Age verification for tobacco/vape/alcohol is manual
  • Case vs. single item pricing is confusing
  • No compliance reporting for regulated products
  • Outdated register with no cloud access
  • Paying too much in processing fees
How We Solve It
  • Integrated ID scanning and age prompts
  • Case & single item pricing built in
  • Compliance and excise duty reporting
  • Cloud-based — reports from your phone
  • Dual pricing / cash discount to eliminate fees
  • Custom label printing for in-house items
🥖

Bodega / Small Grocery

Common Pain Points

  • No inventory tracking — guessing what to reorder

How We Solve It

  • Inventory tracking with reorder alerts
  • EBT/SNAP support on handheld and desktop
  • Real-time sales reporting from any device
  • Affordable entry point — scales as they grow

Objection Handling

When They Push Back, Say This

The most common objections you'll hear from grocery and c-store owners and how to handle them.

"We already have a register / POS system."
"No problem — does it handle EBT, age verification, inventory tracking, and cloud reporting? Most older systems don't. And if you're paying processing fees, our dual pricing program could save you thousands a year. Can I run your numbers?"
"I don't want to switch — it's too much hassle."
"Totally get it. We handle the setup and can import your product catalog. Most stores are up and running same day. And EkiKart can integrate with your existing system if you want to keep it — we don't force you to rip and replace."
"How much does it cost?"
"Depends on the setup, but here's the key — if you're doing $30K+ a month, our dual pricing program can offset your entire processing cost. You'd actually keep more money than you do now. Let me show you what that looks like with your volume."
"I'm a small bodega, I don't need all this."
"That's actually our sweet spot. The PAX A920 is a handheld — it's your register, your card reader, your inventory tracker, all in one device for $457. No big counter setup needed. And it accepts EBT, which means more customers walking through your door."
"Do you support EBT / SNAP?"
"Absolutely — that's one of our biggest features for grocery. EBT transactions work on both our handheld and desktop systems. Secure, fast, and fully compliant. A lot of stores come to us specifically for EBT support."
"We sell tobacco and alcohol — do you handle compliance?"
"Built right in. Integrated ID scanning, age verification prompts at checkout, compliance reporting for excise duties — your cashiers can't accidentally sell to a minor. That keeps you out of trouble and protects your license."
Qualifying the Prospect

Questions to Ask Early in the Call

These help you figure out which bundle to pitch and whether dual pricing is on the table.

1

Monthly Revenue

"Roughly what are you doing in monthly revenue?" — If $30K+, lead with dual pricing. That's your strongest hook.

2

Current Setup

"What are you using right now — a register, a POS system, or just a card terminal?" — Find out how much of an upgrade they need.

3

EBT / SNAP

"Do you accept EBT? Do you want to?" — If they don't have EBT and their customers need it, that's an immediate value-add.

4

Age-Restricted Products

"Do you sell tobacco, vape, or alcohol?" — If yes, compliance features become a major selling point. Ask how they handle ID checks now.

5

Number of SKUs / Departments

"How many products are you carrying? Multiple departments?" — This tells you if they need the full inventory management suite.

6

Locations & Registers

"How many locations? How many registers per store?" — Multi-location and multi-register pushes toward the Better or Best bundle.
